_note: The ID header sits over the second column. RISK-1's ID cell holds an ESC (a terminal colour escape) and a BEL, and a Result with no Threshold, so its id is printed in a finding. RISK-2's Result names no experience reason and holds every bidi embedding, override and isolate (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) and both separators (U+2028, U+2029), so the finding quotes them. PC1 fails the case when any of those characters reaches K1's output raw: this pins each range of the escaper. A lone CR is not here: a shipped file never carries a CR byte (scripts/new-project.test.mjs); scripts/report.test.mjs and S1's control-characters case prove it.
